playback_cpu_vs_phase1.verdict: PASS - playback CPU 0.01% <= phase-1 0.24%. Working set 153.19 MB vs 151.08 MB (+1.4%, sampling noise; no WS threshold per plan).

fps30_vs_fps24_decode.verdict: PASS - no decode-load regression signal: both paths at the CPU measurement floor (0.01 vs 0.00 avg); WS delta +0.4% (153.78 vs 153.19) within sampling noise.

measured.main_loop_thread: 1 wake per 1.5 s tick intact (1500 ms MsgWait timeout, ComputeWaitTimeoutMs); ctx-switch rate 2.90-3.92/s = 0.67/s timeout floor + ~2.2/s in-tick blocking work (~3 switches per tick: EnumWindows + per-window DWM queries), CPU 0.004%, zero periodic log
measured.mpv_event_threads: 2 x ~2/s (mpv_wait_event 500 ms while unpaused, by design)

wakeups_unpaused_idle.verdict: PASS - 1 wake/1.5 s tick intact; ctx-switch rate exceeds wake rate by design (in-tick EnumWindows+DWM blocking work, CPU 0.004%, zero periodic log). Prior 0.63/s was wrong-tid misattribution per D1 (no tidaddr artifact; live main never near 0.63/s unpaused). Caveats C1 (pre-existing IPC 10 Hz, owned by row b) + C2 (mixed-state window, ambient FG-reclaiming game) documented in evidence.

wakeups_paused_60s.threshold: PASS iff mean process-wide ctx-switch rate < 1.0/s over 60 s AND zero periodic log lines
wakeups_paused_60s.verdict: FAIL (USER-APPROVED documented FAIL, blocks bench gate per plan) - 12.5/s >> 1.0/s threshold.
wakeups_paused_60s.cause: IPC ServeLoop 100 ms accept slices (engine/src/ipc_server.cpp:28 kAcceptSliceMs=100 + :124-131 WaitWithStop + :391-392 worker-poll comment): the ~9.6/s churner thread starts in debug-CRT (= engine std::thread; the 2 mpv event threads are silent paused -1 waits), matching the 10 Hz slice rate exactly; same 10/s in the no-video control, so not decode. Pre-existing, untouched by P2 (no ipc_server change in scope). Plus ~1.1/s x 2 libmpv-internal threads (out of engine scope, counted process-wide).
wakeups_paused_60s.fix_direction: lengthen/event-drive the IPC accept slice (needs-fix, out of P2 scope - no prod change made)

occlusion_tick_intentional.note: The 1500 ms unpaused-loop wake (MsgWait timeout doubling as the occlusion cadence) is INTENTIONAL polling - the sole sanctioned periodic wakeup in Phase 2 (plan Todo 9: self-suspending, runs only while SlotsPaused()==false, re-armed by ApplyPauseState transitions). Row (a) confirms no other engine-owned periodic cadence (no 250 ms / 500 ms / 1 s / per-frame lines in the 46-line log delta).

ipc_10hz_residual.note: Pre-existing IPC ServeLoop 100 ms accept slices (~10/s ctx churn, zero CPU - pure wait churn, all threads 0.000-0.008% CPU) survive Phase 2 in ALL states. This is the row (b) FAIL cause; fixing it is explicitly out of P2 scope.

demuxer_ram.note: Demuxer readahead still bounded (demuxer-max-bytes=16MiB, demuxer-max-back-bytes=4MiB, carried over from P1.1). Playback WS 153.19 MB / priv 155.40 MB (30fps) and 153.78 / 155.30 MB (24fps): ~153-155 MB class, no unbounded-growth signal within the 1-min samples.

log_evidence.methodology_note: Todo 17 mined no new engine.log lines; log evidence is cited via the Todo 16 matrix row artifacts (all extracted post-flush per method_logbatch.md discipline).

row_a_log_delta.note: 46-line delta over the 33.6 s unpaused window: only IPC connect/disconnect pairs, hook-event deliveries, genuine transitions. Zero periodic lines.

row_b_log_delta.note: 50-line delta over the paused windows: zero periodic lines - log-silence holds even while the ctx-switch FAIL is present (churn is wait-slice, never logged).
